references.context: Module theory: module generated by a finite set of elements as all their R-linear combinations
Module theory: surjective R-linear map from finite rank free R-module to M
Module theory: finite direct sum of n copies of R, viewed as free module of rank n

references.disposition: The generator count is finite but does not imply the module has finitely many elements.

review_rationale: Reviewed both finite-generator and surjection-from-finite-free-module formulations, where n is finite but arbitrary and no presentation relations are required. Distinguishes finite generation from finite presentation and finite cardinality.
